evidence: Provenance: git rev-parse HEAD printed 80c17f5979b632a38e2a6797ff20504b418e198c before and after the audit, equal to audited_head_sha, so the audit is current. git status --short printed only the pre-existing untracked .opencode/, harness/wt.txt, and tech-debt.md before my two artifacts.

Delta scope: git diff --stat 2a9d421..80c17f5 lists exactly four files: preview-gate.test.ts (+131), pages/real-work.html (+4/-4), preview.sh (+2/-1), plan.md (+23). The plan names these files for tasks 1.20 and 1.21. git diff --name-only 2a9d421..80c17f5 -- docs printed 0 lines, and the diff of real-work.ts plus publish.ts is 0 lines.

Escaping in attributes: preview.sh:316-318 writes `aria-label="{html.escape(name)} table"`, where name is a work_types key of real-work.json. Python html.escape defaults to quote=True. Probe `python3 -I -c` with the input x" onfocus="alert(1)' <b>& printed x" onfocus="alert(1)' <b>&. So a hostile key cannot close the double-quoted attribute or add an event handler. The same escape call already guards the <h3> at :316. real-work.ts:110-120 accepts any string key in work_types, so the escape is the only guard; it holds.

Static values: the new style="overflow-wrap: anywhere" at pages/real-work.html:33 and the two aria-label values `Producer roles table` and `Checker roles table` at :45 and :73 are fixed text in the page template, not export-derived. tabindex="0", role="region", and aria-current="page" are fixed too. The page holds no <script> and no on* attribute added by the delta. The Source paragraph content (file, SHA-256, generated_on) still goes through html.escape at preview.sh:340-342, unchanged.

No private data in attributes: the live .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html holds seven aria-label values: app code table, Checker roles table, docs and ops table, other table, print books table, Producer roles table, tooling table. They are the work-type category names and two fixed role names; none names a person, a school, or a student. The SHA-256 on the page is the spec D16 readable hash, unchanged from the prior round.

No new write path: preview.sh changed in one f-string only (the table-wrap tag). It adds no cp, mkdir, rm, redirect, or file open. The generated page still lands in the preview folder only. git ls-files .tmp printed 0 lines, so no generated file entered git.

No export leak: git grep -l of the full export SHA at 80c17f5 lists measure/tracks/model_guide/metadata.json, plan.md, and spec.md, a subset of the files at 2a9d421. The 32-character prefix also matches adversarial.test.ts:816 and leak-guard.test.ts:21; both are the existing leak-guard needle, present at 2a9d421 and not in this delta. 0 matches in harness/model-guide source or pages.

A6 registry check: measure/tracks.md claims no resolved security state for model_guide (pending), so no claim outruns the implementation. A2: the delta adds no publish path and no draft-to-published flip; the consent gate of publish.ts is unchanged and the public page names no subject.

Test meaning (security view): the U3 test asserts a non-empty aria-label on every table-wrap tag but does not assert escaping of a hostile work-type name in that attribute. The escape is correct in code and my probe, but no test pins it. Not a blocker: the h3 and aria-label share one escape call, and ADV tests in adversarial.test.ts cover export-text escaping for the page body.
